responsibility: This module is the bootstrapped GNU Modula-2 support library and translator front end used to compile and run Modula-2 code within GCC before the full gm2 libraries are in place. It combines two tightly related responsibilities: a self-contained Modula-2 runtime layer, with families such as G*M2RTS, G*Dependent, G*RTExceptions, G*Storage, G*IO/G*FIO/G*StdIO, G*DynamicStrings, G*StringConvert, G*NumberIO, and system-wrapper headers for libc, libm, termios, select, and arguments; and the `mc` source translator/compiler infrastructure, with `Gmc*` files for options, search paths, preprocessing, lexing/token buffering, diagnostics, pretty-printing, fragment streams, and multi-pass parsing (`Gmcp1`-`Gmcp5`). Core compiler data structures and emission live in `Gdecl`, while `GnameKey`, `GsymbolKey`, `Gkeyc`, and list/stack utilities provide symbol management, name mangling, and generic containers. Taken together, `mc-boot` is the bootstrap Modula-2 subsystem that supplies essential runtime semantics, exceptions, I/O, memory, and string services alongside the early front-end pipeline that parses Modula-2 modules, builds and annotates internal trees, and emits translated output.
